openFaceFile.what: Opens the face rig picked in the list (or the custom path, if filled) in a new scene.
examples: Open the face to fix something before installing it again.
Open the face to add a missing blendshape target.
openFaceFile.details: New scene (unsaved changes lost), opens the custom path or the list item, then removes the SHAPES node so the file opens clean.

populate_face_line.tip: Browse for a face rig file.
populate_face_line.what: Opens a file browser and puts the chosen face file in the custom face field.
examples: Use it when the face is not in the list, e.g. a WIP file on your disk.
Browse a face from another project to reuse it.
populate_face_line.details: mh.import_window(extension="maya_file"); the custom field wins over the list.

openBodyFile.what: Opens the body rig picked in the list (or the custom path, if filled) in a new scene.
examples: Open the body to check its skin before installing the face.
Open the body to fix the neck skin before installing.
openBodyFile.details: Same as the face Open: new scene, open, remove the SHAPES node.

populate_body_line.tip: Browse for a body rig file.
populate_body_line.what: Opens a file browser and puts the chosen body file in the custom body field.
examples: Pick the latest body WIP from the asset folder.
Browse a body variant (e.g. armored) to install the same face.
populate_body_line.details: mh.import_window(extension="maya_file"); the custom field wins over the list.

installFaceBtn.tip: Install the face rig on the body rig.
installFaceBtn.what: Opens the face and the body, merges them into one rig and connects the face to the head. Errors are listed at the end.
steps: Pick or browse the face file.
Pick or browse the body file.
Read the error list, then test the face ctrls with the head.
examples: Pick face and body, click Install Face, then check the face ctrls follow the head.
Re-install after fixing the face file: the data node remembers both paths.
Install the same face on a second body variant.
installFaceBtn.details: install_face(): cleans temp files, opens the face, prefixes the rig top groups (geo, rig, control, Global_Ctrl, Mutant_Build...) so they do not clash, imports it into the body and connects the face to the head. Paths and custom code are stored on the Mutant_FaceInstall node (Face / Body / Code attrs).

add_rivets.tip: Make the selected ctrls ride on the geo.
add_rivets.what: Select the face ctrls, then the geometry last. The ctrls get rivets so they stick to the skin as it deforms.
steps: Open the jaw and check the ctrls ride on the skin.
examples: Select the cheek ctrls, then the head geo, click it: the cheeks follow when the jaw opens.
Rivet the nose ctrls so they follow a big snarl shape.
Rivet the brow ctrls to follow the forehead shapes.
add_rivets.details: mt.rivets_ctrls(geometry=last, selection_ctrls=rest): each ctrl gets a rivet on the closest point of the geo and follows it, so ctrls stay on the skin when deformers move it.

remove_rivets.tip: Remove the rivets from the selected ctrls.
remove_rivets.what: Takes the rivets off the selected ctrls (select the geo last, like when adding).
examples: Remove them before moving a ctrl to a new spot, then add them again.
Remove rivets from a ctrl that should stay in place.
remove_rivets.details: mt.remove_rivets_ctrls(selection_ctrls=all but last): keep the geo selected last, the same way you added them.

head_sns.tip: Add squash and stretch to the head.
head_sns.what: Adds the head squash and stretch deformers driven by the upper skull ctrl, on the selected geo.
examples: Select the head geo, click it, scale Skull_Upr_Ctrl to squash the head.
Give a cartoon character a squashy head for takes.
head_sns.details: mt.bend_and_squash_head(geo, "Skull_Upr_Ctrl"): adds SS_Head (squash) and SS_Head_Bend_Side / SS_Head_Bend_Front_Back (bends) driven by the upper skull ctrl.

addToSnS.tip: Add the selection to the head squash and stretch.
addToSnS.what: Adds the selected geos (eyes, teeth, hair...) to the head squash and stretch deformers.
examples: Select the eyebrows geo and click it so they squash with the head.
Add the hat so it squashes with the head.
Add the eyes and teeth so nothing pokes out when squashing.
addToSnS.details: Adds each selected geo to SS_Head_Bend_Side, SS_Head_Bend_Front_Back and SS_Head (cmds.deformer -e -g). Run Helpers > Reorder SnS if the deformer order ends up wrong.

extra_eyes_button.what: Builds the extra eye controls on top of the installed face.
examples: Click it once after Install Face when the character needs them.
Add the extras for close up shots of the eyes.
extra_eyes_button.details: build_extra_eyes(): adds the extra eye ctrls on the installed face.

create_MouthIn.what: Makes the Mouth In shape on the selected geometry so the lips can be pulled into the mouth.
examples: Select the head and lips geos, click it, sculpt the shape, test with the mouth ctrl.
Use it for characters that bite their lips.
create_MouthIn.details: faceinstall_utils.mouth_faceinstall.create_MouthIn(): makes the blendShape target on the selected geos (or the known face geos) inside the facial add-on group.

create_Mouth_RollPull.tip: Create the lip Roll and Pull blendshapes.
create_Mouth_RollPull.what: Makes the lip roll and lip pull shapes on the selected geometry.
examples: Select the head geo, click it, then sculpt the roll shapes.
Sculpt a lip roll for M / B / P mouth shapes.
create_Mouth_RollPull.details: mouth_faceinstall.create_Mouth_RollPull(): Lip_Roll / Lip_Pull targets on the selected geos, wired to the lip ctrls.

mouth_control_follow_setup.tip: Make the mouth ctrls follow the jaw.
mouth_control_follow_setup.what: Constrains the mouth main ctrls to the jaw and lower skull so they move with them.
examples: Click it once, then open the jaw: the lower lip ctrls follow.
Run it after installing a face made before the follow setup existed.
mouth_control_follow_setup.details: Parent constrains the lower mouth main ctrl offset to Jaw_Ctrl and the corners to Jaw_Ctrl + Skull_Lwr_Ctrl (mo=True), with follow groups on top. Run it once: it makes groups and constraints with fixed names, a second run errors or doubles them.

eyes_follow_head.what: Sets Eyes_Main_Ctrl Follow to 0 so the eyes stay with the head.
examples: Click it when the eyes drift while turning the head.
Turn it off for a shot where the eyes should lock on a target.

eyelids_control_follow_setup.tip: Make the eyelid ctrls follow the blinks.
eyelids_control_follow_setup.what: Groups the mid eyelid ctrls and connects them so they move with the blink.
examples: Click it once, then blink: the mid lid ctrls ride along.
Run it so animators can tweak the lid shape mid blink.
eyelids_control_follow_setup.details: Groups <side>Eyelids_UpMid / DwMid ctrls under *_Blinks_Follow_Grp and connects the blink ctrls tx into them. Run it once: it makes groups and constraints with fixed names, a second run errors or doubles them.

openInstalledFace.tip: Open the face file this rig was installed from.
openInstalledFace.what: Reads the face path saved in this rig and opens that file.
examples: Go back to the face source to fix a shape.
Fix a face shape and Install Face again.
openInstalledFace.details: Reads Mutant_FaceInstall.Face and opens that file (force, unsaved changes lost).

openInstalledBody.tip: Open the body file this rig was installed from.
openInstalledBody.what: Reads the body path saved in this rig and opens that file.
examples: Go back to the body source to fix its skin.
Paint body weights and Install Face again.
openInstalledBody.details: Reads Mutant_FaceInstall.Body and opens that file (force, unsaved changes lost).

load_from_node.what: Shows the custom code stored in this rig in the field below.
examples: Check what extra code ran on the last install.
Copy the custom code to another character install.
load_from_node.details: Shows Mutant_FaceInstall.Code in the field. Edit it there to keep fixes with the rig.

run.what: Runs the custom code stored in this rig (Python, or MEL if it is not Python).
examples: Run the extra fixes again after changing the face.
Run the fixes again after a manual change on the rig.
run.details: exec() the code in Mutant_FaceInstall.Code; if Python fails it is tried as MEL.

move_master.tip: Move the Global ctrl far away.
move_master.what: Moves and rotates the Global ctrl a lot, to test that the whole face follows.
examples: Click it, look for any face part left behind, then Restore Master.
Find a face part that does not follow the Global scale.
move_master.details: Global_Ctrl to translate 300 / rotate 300 / scale 5 (or .size 5 on rigs without scale). Restore Master puts it back to 0 / 1.

restore_master.what: Sets the Global ctrl back to zero after Move Master.
examples: Click it after checking the rig follows.
Restore before saving the rig.

show_all_face_ctrls.what: Turns on all the face ctrl visibility switches.
examples: Show them all to check every ctrl moves the right area.
Show everything for a skinning check, then restore preset A.
show_all_face_ctrls.details: Sets every face visibility attr on Vis_Ctrl to 1 (skull, eyes, lips, brows, cheeks, jaw, tongue, teeth, nose; main / mid / tweak).

restore_vis_switches_a.tip: Set the face ctrls visibility to preset A.
restore_vis_switches_a.what: Sets the face visibility switches back to the A preset for animators.
examples: Click it before publishing the rig.
Give animators the default face ctrl set.
restore_vis_switches_a.details: Sets the Vis_Ctrl face attrs to preset A (main and mid ctrls on, tweaks off).

restore_vis_switches_b.tip: Set the face ctrls visibility to preset B.
restore_vis_switches_b.what: Sets the face visibility switches to the B preset (fewer ctrls).
examples: Use it for animators that only want the main face ctrls.
Use B for crowd shots where the face only needs main ctrls.
restore_vis_switches_b.details: Sets the Vis_Ctrl face attrs to preset B.

frame_face.tip: Frame the face in the viewport.
frame_face.what: Selects the skull ctrls for a moment and frames them, so the camera fits the face.
examples: Click it to jump back to the face after looking at the body.
Frame the face before capturing a note.
frame_face.details: Shows Vis_Ctrl.skullMainCtrls for a moment, frames Skull_Lwr_Ctrl + Skull_Upr_Ctrl, then puts the vis back.

frame_body.what: Frames the whole rig in the viewport.
examples: Click it to see the full body again.
Frame the body after Move Master to find the rig.

zero_all.what: Puts every ctrl back to its rest pose (translate, rotate and scale), except the Vis ctrl.
examples: Click it after testing poses to give the rig back clean.
Reset after testing the face sliders.
Zero everything before a ROM so the poses start clean.
zero_all.details: Every *_Ctrl except Vis_Ctrl: translate / rotate to 0, scale to 1 (locked attrs are skipped), and the tool sliders back to 0.
